# Wire Contract Checklist: Resource Descriptor on Actual Cost Requests

**Purpose**: Test the requirements for the new `GetActualCostRequest.resource` field: proto comment
completeness, fallback and precedence rules, validation layers, and backward compatibility
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only
when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not
mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec state the field number, the reused message type, and that field 10 stays unused?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all four rules the proto comment must carry (same meaning as projected, unset fallback, tags meaning,
  set precedence) listed as separate requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the pagination rule (same descriptor on every page) stated as a requirement and not only as an edge
  case? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for both validator layers, including what each does when the field is unset?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the documentation surface enumerated by document name so its completion is checkable? [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "pricing dimensions" defined by listing which descriptor fields it covers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it clear that the request `tags` are neither merged into nor allowed to override the descriptor?
  [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the relationship between `resource_id` and `resource.id` stated, including that the SDK does not
  compare them? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "the same descriptor rules the SDK applies elsewhere" specific about which rule set each layer uses?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Plan research R2–R3]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "in a way a test can observe" for the reference plugin made concrete in the plan? [Clarity, Spec
  §FR-011, data-model]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are the descriptor rules on the actual path consistent with those on projected, supports, and batch
  paths, so one descriptor is valid or invalid the same way everywhere? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the dry-run statement consistent between the edge cases ("may carry a descriptor; validated if set")
  and FR-006 ("dry run is otherwise unchanged")? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the reference plugin requirement stay consistent with Principle III (no cost value depends on the
  descriptor)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Constitution III]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the conformance level of the new check consistent with the other actual cost checks? [Consistency,
  Spec §FR-012, Plan research R5]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-001 ("every pricing input it reads on the projected path") be verified without a specific plugin
  implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the zero-allocation requirement scoped precisely (which request shapes must stay at 0 allocs/op)?
  [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-005 tied to a named compatibility check and baseline branch? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a descriptor that is present but empty, on both validator layers? [Edge
  Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for a cloud tag whose key collides with a routing key (`region`, `sku`,
  `provider`)? [Edge Case, Spec §US1 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the cross-version matrix covered (new host with old plugin, old host with new plugin)? [Coverage, Spec
  §US2]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the error precedence defined when a request has both an existing violation (for example an empty
  `resource_id`) and an invalid descriptor? [Coverage, data-model §Validation]
- [ ] CHK022 Are host redaction expectations for `attributes` on the actual path stated, including that the SDK cannot
  detect them? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 Is the host-side work (core building the descriptor) recorded as an out-of-scope dependency rather than
  an implied requirement? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the exclusion of the batch request justified by the proto (batch does not embed the actual cost
  request)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the decision not to add a capability flag justified? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
